newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX slightly firms led by VSZ.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX slightly firms led by VSZ.

text.p: Slovakia's Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) continued with thin activity on Tuesday, with the 16-share SAX index slightly boosted by a higher average price from steel maker VSZ.
The index closed at 168.75 points, up 0.16 from Monday.
VSZ, traditionally the most liquid Bratislava blue chip, traded 10,194 shares, closing unchanged at 650 crowns, but with an average price up 0.6 percent.
Apart from VSZ, volumes traded on the BSE's automated system were low.
The most heavily-weighted share on the SAX, oil refinery Slovnaft traded only 46 shares, closing unchanged at 840, while commercial bank VUB saw no shares matched.
Overall, volume eased to 507,672 shares, from 703,358 shares traded on Monday, while turnover increased to 284.1 million crowns, from 277.1 million.
